rawFindings.title: Incorrect handling of TemplateLiteral nodes in hasNonLiteral function
rawFindings.explanation: The change removes the handling that allowed TemplateLiteral nodes to return false, instead now hasNonLiteral returns true for any node type other than Literal, which will cause TemplateLiteral nodes to be incorrectly classified as non-literals. This breaks correct detection of template literals and can cause false positives or negatives.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the conditional that checks for UnaryExpression nodes and also allow TemplateLiteral node types to return false, i.e., revert to the original logic that returns false for nodes of type Literal or TemplateLiteral.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect hasNonLiteral() behavior ignores TemplateLiteral type
rawFindings.explanation: The function hasNonLiteral() originally returned true for nodes that are not Literal or TemplateLiteral, correctly treating TemplateLiteral as a literal type. The change removes TemplateLiteral from the condition, which causes template literals to be treated as non-literals, breaking the rule logic.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the original condition to treat TemplateLiteral nodes as literals by returning node.type !== 'Literal' && node.type !== 'TemplateLiteral';
